prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app decision comp, 1440x1000 landscape
Primary request: Design the Neuronauts VS-mode live match as “Orbital Tug”: the shared semantic map is the dominant contest, visually pulled between red and blue telemetry rails. This is an operational game screen, not a poster.
Input images: Image 1 is a visual identity reference only. Preserve its near-black green canvas, matte outlined panels, sturdy sans typography, crisp custom pixel glyphs, small colorful astronaut avatars, restrained spacing, and strictly no-glow/no-glass/no-gradient character. Do not copy its landing content or layout.
Structure: slim mission header; narrow red team telemetry rail on the left and narrow blue team rail on the right, each with team name, overall best/average/guess count/hints, 3 compact player rows, typing indicators and per-person stats; center 55% is a large square semantic space with many tiny red and blue points orbiting an unlabeled target, a strong head-to-head progress read across its top, and no labels on opponent dots; below the map sits the current team’s wide guess input; beneath that, a dense private flight log is visible enough to prove ongoing use. Show one team already finished while the other is allowed to continue.
Style/medium: polished production web UI screenshot, instrument-like hierarchy but human and playful, authentic semantic word-game data, one memorable spatial map rather than many cards.
Color palette: #101613 canvas, #171f1c panels, off-white text, #d95a5a red team, #5b91d8 blue team, #65cdb9 utility accent, amber hints.
Text (verbatim where prominent): “RED SHIFT”, “BLUE ORBIT”, “VS”, “SEMANTIC SPACE”, “YOUR TEAM”, “OPPONENT”, “Transmit guess”, “Keep searching”.
Constraints: opponent words must not appear anywhere; own flight-log words may appear; clear 44px controls; accessible contrast; no invented claims; no gradients, glassmorphism, neon glow, generic lucide icons, bento-card collage, or excessive rounded pills. The map must be the unmistakable focal point without making the guessing task hard to find.
